name: @lacuna/image-ops
description: Pure functions for canvas image manipulation: resize, crop, rotate, flip, CSS-like filters, and format encoding.

lacunaBridge.signature: resizeImageData(src: ImageData, width: number, height: number); cropImageData(src: ImageData, rect: CropRect); rotateImageData(src: ImageData, degrees: 90 | 180 | 270); flipImageData(src: ImageData, axis: 'horizontal' | 'vertical')
